name: Doutori Saki
source:
Although she is all alone in the world, she is cheerful, bright, and easy to get along with.
They met at "Yu-ai," a student support group supported by Ayane, and
are employed as Tsukiya's live-in tutor.
She is like an older sister to both Mizuki and Tsukiya, and is willing to give them advice on various things.
Because she has a big butt, she tends to get depressed when people point it out.
She absolutely hates ghosts and snakes!

"This butt... aaah, I can't find anything that fits so I end up wearing stretch pants."
